title: has_oscore_option: unchecked pos += len can wrap on 32-bit
description:
Line 233: `pos += len` where len can be up to 65804 (from extended CoAP option length encoding: 65535 + 269). On 32-bit systems with contrived input, this could theoretically wrap, causing the parser to re-read earlier buffer contents.

Practical impact: Low. SCHC packets are constrained by LoRa MTU (~200 bytes), and 32-bit systems cannot allocate 4GB buffers. However, for correctness and defense-in-depth:

Fix: Use checked_add:
```rust
pos = pos.checked_add(len).ok_or(SchcError::TooShort(...))?;
```
